title: Hammachuu Lafaa
intro: Yeroo qormaata guddaa keessa, namni dhuunfaa beekamaan tokko baay’inni addunyaa guddaa, qormaata galateeffannaa fi gad of deebisuu kennameefii ture. Imalli fakkii kanaa qabeenyi qaamaa yeroo muraasaaf darbuu fi bu’aa of tuulummaa irratti barumsa gadi fagoo ta’ee tajaajila. Eenyummaa lubbuu seenaan ishee lafa nu jala jiru keessatti bocame kanaa saaxi.
clues: Ummata ergamaa guddaa tokkoon qajeelfamu keessa jiraadhe.
Rabbiin badhaadhina bal’aa akkasii naaf kenne, furtuun qabeenya koo iyyuu namoota dhuunfaa ciccimoo hedduudhaaf ba’aa guddaa ta’e.

Ummanni kiyya qabeenya kiyya beekee waan Rabbiin naaf kenneen mana jireenyaa aakhiraa akkan barbaaduu fi qooda koo addunyaa irraa akkan hin daganne, akkasumas akkuma Rabbiin waan gaarii naaf godhe gaarii akkan hojjedhu na gorsan.
Qabeenyi koo inni guddaan beekumsaa fi carraaqqii mataa koo qofaan akka argame of tuulummaadhaan labse, tola waaqayyoo kamiyyuu dhorke.
Arjummaa Rabbii akkan gumaachu ykn beekamtii akkan kennu yeroo gaafataman, qabeenyi koo kan koo qofa ta’uu amanee boonsaan dide.
Bu’aa of tuulummaa fi cunqursaa koo garmalee irraa kan ka’e, Rabbiin dachii akka banattee na fi mana jireenyaa koo akka liqimsitu ajaje.
arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verse: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves. (28:81)
